responses: {"business_context":"Depo Luxe presents itself as a creative agency or studio specializing in a 'strategic and cinematic approach to contemporary luxury.' The focus is on high-end, visually sophisticated branding and campaigns, likely catering to luxury fashion, design, and lifestyle clients.","audience":"The target audience is creative directors, brand executives, and marketing managers within luxury, fashion, and cultural sectors who value avant-garde aesthetics and strategic visual communication.","conversion_goal":"To secure inquiries and project briefs from potential luxury clients seeking elevated, cinematic brand narratives and campaign direction. Secondary goals include showcasing portfolio highlights and establishing brand ethos.","first_viewport_logic":"Both desktop and mobile hero sections immerse visitors immediately with a large, visually arresting background video or image (with a distinctive art direction), overlaid with minimalist, centered text showing a featured project ('Numéro France'), the authorship (Gus And Lo), concise navigation, and a custom cookie policy prompt. No direct call-to-action dominates; the focus is on ambience and intrigue.","information_architecture":["Top-level navigation: Featured, Archive, Talent, Approach, Contact","Brand masthead with tagline","Prominently displayed featured work title and credit","Cookie consent banner accessible from the outset"],"narrative_storytelling":"Cinematic visual storytelling dominates the homepage, situating the visitor within an artful, moody scene that feels editorial and immersive. Text overlays are sparse and poetic, relying on visual emotional resonance over explanatory copy. The narrative positions the agency as visionary and creatively driven.","composition_grid":"Centered, vertical stacking of content. Overall, the grid follows a high-fashion editorial sensibility with asymmetrical framing and large negative spaces.","spacing_rhythm":"Significant negative space between content elements, reinforcing sophistication and a luxury feel. Text is spaced apart, not crowded, with navigation links given wide kerning and separate placement. Cookie banner is respectfully sized and offset to the edge.","typography":"Classic, serif typeface (“Numéro France” headline) for creative gravitas, paired with modern, lightweight sans-serif for navigation, tagline, and supporting text, evoking timelessness and clarity. Letter spacing and italics elevate the fashion editorial tone.","palette_contrast":"Muted, almost monochromatic backgrounds defocused to foreground the text; white text on darker grounds achieves legibility and contrast. All interactions remain clear and minimal on smaller screens.","learn":["How to let an immersive media background and minimalist type hierarchy communicate luxury without crowding or cliché.","The effectiveness of centering content and using generous negative space to convey exclusivity.","Pairing cinematic visuals with classic typefaces for instant editorial depth."],"do_not_copy":["Do not obscure navigation or essential brand information in pursuit of minimalism—clarity remains key.","Do not allow cookie banners to overwhelm or obscure hero content on smaller screens—maintain proportionality.","Do not use generic or non-distinctive imagery; all media must support brand mood and sophistication."],"reusable_cross_category_traits":["Full-viewport cinematic hero with poetic text overlay.","Minimal navigation with high typographic refinement.","Subtle, respectful cookie consent integration."],"traits":["Editorial, cinematic art direction.","Luxury-oriented restraint and visual hierarchy.","Typography-driven, negative space-focused layout."]}
